title: Relative Proj is invariant under tensoring by an invertible module
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal E$ be a finite type quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-module [pqf-def-coherent], let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_S$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and let $n\ge0$. There is a canonical isomorphism over $S$ between the projective bundles $\mathbf P_S(\mathcal E)=\operatorname{Proj}_S(\operatorname{Sym}_{\mathcal O_S}\mathcal E)$ and $\mathbf P_S(\mathcal E\otimes_{\mathcal O_S}\mathcal L^{\otimes n})$, commuting with their structure morphisms to $S$ [def-trf-projective-bundle-morphism; def-nagata-relative-proj].

source.place: Lemma Tag 02NC (constructions-lemma-twisting-and-proj), canonical relative-Proj isomorphism for the graded twist

proof.text: Choose frames $e_i$ of $\mathcal L$ on an open cover using [def-sc-invertible-module], and refine it to affine opens $U_i$ using [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis]. Put $\mathcal E_n=\mathcal E\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes n}$. By [lem-trf-framed-symmetric-twist-comparison], this module is quasi-coherent of finite type, and each frame supplies a graded $\mathcal O_{U_i}$-algebra isomorphism $\beta_i:\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal E)|_{U_i}\to\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal E_n)|_{U_i}$ fixing scalars, normalized by $v\mapsto v\otimes e_i^{\otimes n}$.

source.place: Tag 02NC, label lemma-twisting-and-proj, proof: trivialize the invertible module and glue; symmetric-algebra specialization

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-local-proj-isomorphism-compatibility] to $\beta_i$. Its hypotheses hold: $\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal E)$ and $\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal E_n)$ are quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_S$-algebra sheaves by [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-symmetric-algebra] (applied to the quasi-coherent modules $\mathcal E$ and $\mathcal E_n$ of step 1), graded by symmetric degree, and their relative Proj are $\mathbf P_S(\mathcal E)$ and $\mathbf P_S(\mathcal E_n)$ [def-trf-projective-bundle-morphism]. It gives inverse isomorphisms $g_i:\mathbf P_S(\mathcal E_n)|_{U_i}\to\mathbf P_S(\mathcal E)|_{U_i}$ over $U_i$ with the specified fraction formulas. The same node gives compatibility with every further affine-base restriction, for both directions.

source.place: Tag 02NC, label lemma-twisting-and-proj, proof: trivialize the invertible module and glue; symmetric-algebra specialization

proof.text: For each overlap $U_i\cap U_j$, choose an affine cover $V$ using [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis]. The frame isomorphisms $a\mapsto ae_i$ and $a\mapsto ae_j$ from [def-sc-invertible-module] give $e_j|_V=ue_i|_V$ and $e_i|_V=ve_j|_V$; applying either inverse frame yields $uv=1$, so $u$ is a unit. By the restriction clause of the framed comparison, $\beta_i|_V=\beta_{e_i|_V}$ and $\beta_j|_V=\beta_{e_j|_V}$, and its unit clause for $e_j|_V=u\,e_i|_V$ gives $\beta_j|_V=u^{nk}\beta_i|_V$ on $\mathcal A_k|_V$ [lem-trf-framed-symmetric-twist-comparison]. Apply the unit-invariance clause of [lem-trf-local-proj-isomorphism-compatibility] with the unit $u^n$, together with its restriction clause: $g_i|_V=g_j|_V$, and their inverses agree too. Uniqueness in [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing] then gives agreement on the whole overlap.

source.place: Tag 02NC, label lemma-twisting-and-proj, proof: trivialize the invertible module and glue; symmetric-algebra specialization

proof.text: Compose each $g_i$ with the target open inclusion, and glue on the source opens $\mathbf P_S(\mathcal E_n)|_{U_i}$ by [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing]; these cover the source since the $U_i$ cover $S$. Glue the inverses on $\mathbf P_S(\mathcal E)|_{U_i}$ likewise. Their composites are identities since they are identities over every $U_i$; their structure-map equalities also hold globally by the same uniqueness. Comparing any two covers and their frames on common affine refinements by step 3 proves independence of all choices and uniqueness with the local frame normalization. Invert the resulting $S$-isomorphism to obtain $\mathbf P_S(\mathcal E)\cong\mathbf P_S(\mathcal E_n)$ in the projective-bundle convention [def-trf-projective-bundle-morphism]. The zeroth-power normalization is supplied by the framed comparison.
